rulings.restated: Choose — [helper "Did you receive or pay alimony or separate maintenance in 2025 under a divorce or separation agreement entered into on or before December 31, 2018, or must you include or may you deduct a recapture of alimony?" = true → helper "Alimony received, before the screen for more than one agreement, recapture and child support"] [helper "Did you receive or pay alimony or separate maintenance in 2025 under a divorce or separation agreement entered into on or before December 31, 2018, or must you include or may you deduct a recapture of alimony?" = false → helper "Year parameter sales.zero"]
rulings.model: The gate requires an agreement 'not changed after 2018' to expressly exclude alimony, so such an agreement gives zero for the whole year. Pub. 504, Certain Rules for Instruments Executed or Modified After 2018, Example 2, says payments 'made in January 2025 through May 2025 are includible in the recipient's income' when the modification took effect in June 2025.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding (F1 in fixr2/s1.findings.md; amount-affecting, the year an agreement is changed). p504 p. 16, Certain Rules for Instruments Executed or Modified After 2018, Example 2: "the modification expressly provided that the post-2018 alimony rules apply. The alimony payments made in January 2025 through May 2025 are includible in the recipient's income and deductible from the payer's income. The alimony payments made in June 2025 through December 2025 are neither includible ... nor deductible". The model is right: the gate s1.alimony asks "Did you receive or pay alimony ... under a divorce or separation agreement entered into on or before December 31, 2018 (and not changed after 2018 to expressly provide that alimony received isn't included in income) ...", so a filer whose agreement was changed in 2025 answers no and line 2a is zero for the whole year, though the amount question itself (s1.alimony_received, "or payments made after the agreement was changed ...") and the register's chosen reading (amb.2025.alimony_screen: amounts "after a change that expressly excludes them, are not asked") count the payments before the change. i1040gi p. 89, Line 2a ("unless that agreement was changed after December 31, 2018, ...") does not address the split year; p504 does. Witness (engine eval of stage16.small.s2 varied, single, $1,000 a month): s1.alimony false gives line 2a $0.00, AGI $30,000, tax (line 24) $1,475.00; s1.alimony true with the January-May $5,000 gives line 2a $5,000.00, AGI $35,000, tax $2,075.00. Pre-existing wording, not introduced by the fix round. The BUG-0240 rewording of s1.alimony_received is ruled in F2 (cosmetic).

rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. oi8z.taxable is each line 8z entry's taxable amount, defined in forms/2025/oi8z.yaml: an entry's kind comes from a fixed list (decision D4), reemployment trade adjustment assistance and kickbacks are computed and every other kind is refused at the entry (i1040gi p. 92, Line 8z, "Examples of income to report on line 8z include the following"; p525 p. 34, Kickbacks). Those entries are judged in the render log of `oi8z`, where they are given.
